title: Fig. 25: Gemini GT-4 Launch Area Recovery Forces diagram
description: Illustrated diagram titled "LAUNCH AREA RECOVERY FORCES" showing a shaded "LANDING FOOTPRINT (27 MILES LONG)" off the launch site with "2 MINESWEEPER OCEAN GOING SHIPS (MSO)," "USMC AMPHIBS" and "USA M 113 LARK TANKS" positioned along it. Annotations note an auxiliary rescue ship (ARS) 50 miles out on a 72-degree heading and "FOUR HELICOPTERS TWO PHOTO JETS." From NASA document M-913-65-04, page 22.
